items.titolo: Here’s Why You Shouldn’t Use AI to Vote
items.descrizione: From hallucinations to partisan bias, artificial intelligence chatbots like ChatGPT and Claude are not helpful when it comes to Election Day.

items.titolo: AI model gets a 32-bit RISC-V CPU compiled directly into its weights, then runs DOOM on it
items.descrizione: Qwenputer is an experimental blend of the stock Qwen 3.5 4B LLM with a 32-bit RISC-V CPU compiled and inserted directly into its weights.
